owner_once_actions: Obtain independent CodeAudit and ProductQA for the final exact SHA; no developer self-signing.
Select a legal official CLI identity in a protected environment; never paste credentials into issues.
Obtain independently verifiable provider-enforced per-call AND aggregate USD/Token allowances; unsupported means STOP, not a timeout substitute.
Approve one scoped hosted environment with App/OIDC/KMS, independent reviewer identities, protected FF-only state ref, network and filesystem isolation and HALT.
Explicitly approve one audited activation commit and one nonproduction readonly pilot with a fixed budget; main merge, Secrets and event/tick installation require separate explicit authorization.
stop_rule: If external identity or enforceable billing boundaries are unavailable, remain BLOCKED and stop adding Runner packages.
candidate_binding: Generated CLI/CI evidence fills candidate_sha from the exact reviewed Git commit; null is never an approval.
